value.rationale: This is a complete exact invariant of the first class-three unitriangular Lie algebra over arbitrary finite fields, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Two nonzero output levels, with ratio exactly two, recover the third lower-central space solely from prescribed bracket frequencies, unlike class-two Heisenberg or radical-square-zero examples. It settles the full fixed-target count and commutator width for a canonical natural algebra with direct relevance to representation- and finite-ring commutator distributions.
